name: Fish Audio S2 Pro
about: Fish Audio's S2 Pro (8-bit MLX, mlx-speech): clones a voice from a sample and its exact transcript (use a sample in the text's language); inline [tags] like [whisper] or [excited] steer the delivery, instruct becomes such a tag; 44.1 kHz; about 2× real time on an M1 Max once loaded, 12 GB at the peak. Non-commercial, the weights may not be passed on
